name: Solana
description:
Verify your Solana wallet. 

Link your wallet to your Discord profile to provide metadata like:

- Wallet Age (based on date of first transaction)
- Recently Active Wallet (based on date of most recent transaction)
- Funded Wallet (does wallet have at least 0.1 Sol?)
- Bonfida Shortname (if applicable)

Server admins can use this data to create "verified roles" and gate channels on those roles.
